name: mcpee-dba
description: Boost DBA 360: agents, skills, specs, patterns and templates for expert SQL Server operations and modernization.

scripts.validate:prompts-evals: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const read=(p)=>JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8')); const catalog=read('prompts/catalog.json'); const suite=read('evals/suite.json'); for (const p of catalog.prompts||[]) { if (!fs.existsSync(p.path)) throw new Error('Missing prompt: '+p.path); } for (const s of suite.evals||[]) { if (!fs.existsSync(s.file)) throw new Error('Missing eval: '+s.file); const ev=read(s.file); if (!ev.prompt) throw new Error('Eval without prompt: '+s.file); if (!fs.existsSync(ev.prompt)) throw new Error('Eval references missing prompt: '+ev.prompt); } console.log('Prompts/Evals OK');"
scripts.quality: npm run validate:json && npm run validate:prompts-evals
